name: ANGEL_OF_THE_LORD
canonical: the Angel of the LORD, a radiant towering CREATED heavenly messenger of awesome presence and NO wings (a sent angel, NOT a depiction of God Himself — theophany/identity-as-God scenes use glory-light instead), a luminous beardless youthful face framed by light-touched flowing hair, robed in shining white-and-gold raiment, brilliant radiance pouring around him from a torn-open sky
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
